title: Swarm in the Abyss
description: A dark abstract painting featuring a dense field of overlapping multicolored circles and dots occupying the lower half of the canvas. The upper portion dissolves into deep black and smoky brown tones with faint wisps of white smoke and scattered golden fragments drifting upward.
prompt: Dark abstract painting with a massive swarm of overlapping multicolored circles and dots filling the bottom half of the frame, fading into deep black and smoky brown atmospheric haze above, with delicate white smoke tendrils and tiny golden fragments floating through the darkness, heavy textured oil painting style, moody and ominous atmosphere
